chunks: He, peace be upon him, was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"And there is no town but We shall destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it."
He said: "It is perishing through death."

key_terms.قَوْلِ: statement or saying, here referring to the Qur'anic verse
key_terms.مُهْلِكُوهَا: destroying it or causing its end

ai.seo_question: What does the verse about every town being destroyed before the Day of Resurrection mean?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explains this verse as referring to the passing away of a population through death before the Day of Resurrection. The explanation clarifies that the divine destruction mentioned here includes the universal human reality of mortality.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.562 – Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the meaning of the verse from Allah’s (swt) Book:
"And there is no town but We shall destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with severe punishment." (Surah Al-Isra 17:58)
Imam (as) said: "It refers to perishing through death”.
